glossary.definition: The role accountable for decisions and review of a defined process.
An agreed statement of where mapped work starts and ends, identifying the inputs received, outputs handed off, and decisions for which the owner is responsible.
The transfer of an output from one role or process to a receiving role, considered complete only when the receiver has what it needs to act.

recordNames: Map including what it includes, excludes, and the decisions it supports
Completed process record or physical output
Vendor statements or demonstrated behavior record
Review record noting date, evidence examined, disagreements, and resolution owners

example.label: Illustrative example
example.description: An unnamed Canadian manufacturer evaluates a process map for a production workflow; all situations and records are hypothetical.

reviewedChapters.title: Map current processes: process mapping software for quality management
reviewedChapters.summary: All four subsections cover map current processes within the assigned scope, correctly attribute vendor descriptions and ISO APG guidance, include workflow elements (roles, inputs, decisions, records, exceptions), provide the required illustrative example, and use the two permitted source URLs appropriately. No FAQ sections are present, which is correct as none are assigned. No unresolved findings from the previous review exist, and the changed paragraphs introduce no new problems. The page passes all checks.
decisions: Determine ownership, acceptance and next action for the mapping purpose
Resolve disagreement on mapping purpose before treating the map as a basis for a software decision
Decide which workflow to examine and record that choice with the map
Determine whether a boundary difference belongs on a common map, a linked local instruction, or a separate process
Decide whether a process, instruction, or role assignment needs correction when written procedure differs from actual records
Decide whether the boundary or the actual handoff needs clarification when inspection evidence arrives after release
Assign a resolution owner for any unresolved escalation route
Decide who can view, propose, review, and release a map change and how those decisions are recorded
